name: Light Leak
description: A warm film light leak that blooms over the frame and retracts, covering a cut at its midpoint.
useWhen: Soft, cinematic transitions between scenes or clips, reveals, the drop of a song, a dreamy or nostalgic look. Put it on a track above both clips and center it on the cut (from = cut frame − half its length).

seed.label: Pattern
seed.help: Different numbers give different leak shapes.

flash.label: Bloom at the cut
flash.help: A brief soft white flash at the midpoint.
